title: Light's Changes
description: Just some basic improvements and changes to minecraft that I found to be useful.
body:
Some basic changes to minecraft that I made to adds some fun new features.
Features:
- Changes to fishing (new drops and altered percentages, refer to gallery)
- The ability to turn any enchanted books to regular books and gain back some experience 

To perform the conversion, hold an enchanted book in your mainhand then use the keyboard shortcut to move it to your offhand. NOTE: this will convert all enchanted books in your inventory so beware.
